list.name: Changes
list.comment:
feat: Replace Render backend deploys with unified Vercel deploy pipeline
Replaced the backend-specific Render deploy workflow with a unified GitHub Actions pipeline for deploying both the frontend and backend to Vercel. Standardized environment management, database migrations, and deploy orchestration for consistency across development and production environments. Updated documentation and Vercel configuration accordingly.

task.summary: Cleanup: Remove unused components, APIs, and dependencies for frontend simplification
feat: Add customizable profile avatar picker with emoji, glyph, and color options

feat: Standardize activity scaling and emphasize simplified visual feedback
Introduce reusable activity intensity utilities with `activityLevelFor` and theme-specific classes for consistent heatmap and chart visuals. Refactor dashboard and landing elements to use unified scaling logic and styles for a polished, cohesive user experience.

refactor: Consolidate frontend guidance into `AGENTS.md` and remove `CLAUDE.md`
Migrated and standardized all frontend architecture rules, Cache Components guidance, and UI/UX conventions into `apps/frontend/AGENTS.md`. Removed redundant `CLAUDE.md` and updated references across the repo. Simplified, clarified, and improved accessibility of key developer documentation.

clarity: Update StatCard and AGENTS.md to refine emphasis styles
Revised `solid` emphasis description in `StatCard` and `AGENTS.md` to specify themed icon disc (`bg-card`) usage for improved visual consistency. Updated associated component logic for better tone handling.

feat: Introduce session-scoped caching and invalidation for improved performance and UI responsiveness
Added session-based caching utilities for user data, ambitions, notifications, and settings. Implemented matching invalidation methods to ensure cache consistency after mutations. Updated components and API calls to leverage the new caching for faster load times and reduced server overhead.

refactor: Remove shared package and migrate schemas, types, and utilities to app-specific directories
Eliminated `@ambitiousyou/shared` package and distributed its schemas, types, and utilities into `apps/backend` and `apps/frontend`. Updated imports and structure for better modularity and maintainability.

refactor: Replace `src/*` path aliases with relative imports and adjust formatting across files
Updated all `src/*` imports to relative paths for compatibility with the Vercel Nest builder and Node CJS runtime. Enforced consistent formatting on long type definitions and array mappings. Added ESLint rule to restrict `src/*` imports.

Updated documentation and Vercel configuration accordingly.
